items.exampleEn: There are no stupid questions in this class.
items.exampleZh: 在這堂課上，沒有愚蠢的問題。

items.exampleEn: Deep water fills her with terror.
The police said the man was innocent.
items.exampleZh: 警方說那名男子是無辜的。

items.exampleEn: She gets great satisfaction from helping others.
items.exampleZh: 她從幫助別人中得到很大的滿足。

items.exampleEn: These shoes are made for comfort, not style.
items.exampleZh: 這雙鞋講究的是舒適，不是外型。

items.exampleEn: Many people are scared of flying.
Leaving my hometown was painful for me.
The movie mixes humor and sadness.
items.exampleZh: 這部電影融合了幽默與哀傷。

items.sentenceEn: I was scared when the dog started barking at me.
items.sentenceZh: 那隻狗開始對我叫的時候，我很害怕。

items.audioEn: The hotel staff did everything for our comfort, so we had a great stay.
items.audioZh: 飯店員工盡一切讓我們住得舒適，所以我們住得很愉快。
items.questionZh: 說話者覺得這次住宿怎麼樣？
options: The hotel was too far away.

items.sentenceEn: His sense of humor makes every meeting more fun.
items.sentenceZh: 他的幽默感讓每次開會都更有趣。

items.sentenceEn: The little boy looked innocent, but he had eaten all the cookies.
items.sentenceZh: 那個小男孩一臉無辜，但他其實把餅乾全吃光了。

items.stemEn: Don't feel ____; anyone can make that mistake.
items.stemZh: 別覺得自己笨，任何人都可能犯那種錯。

items.stemEn: Customer ____ is our top goal, so please answer every complaint.
items.stemZh: 顧客滿意是我們最重要的目標，所以請回覆每一則抱怨。

items.passageEn: Last summer, my daughter Amy went to a camp in the mountains for the first time. Initially, she was scared of the dark at night, and she called me in terror. It was painful to hear her cry, but I told her to be brave. Luckily, the camp leaders had a great sense of humor, and they made the children laugh. Soon Amy found comfort in her new friends. She came home with a look of deep satisfaction. Now she is eager to go again next year.
items.passageZh: 去年夏天，我女兒 Amy 第一次去山上參加營隊。一開始她晚上很怕黑，驚恐地打電話給我。聽她哭讓我很難過，但我要她勇敢一點。幸好營隊領隊很有幽默感，把孩子們逗得哈哈大笑。很快地，Amy 就從新朋友那裡得到了安慰。她回家時一臉心滿意足，現在已經迫不及待明年再去了。

questions.questionZh: Amy 一開始為什麼打電話？

items.promptZh: 她的話給了我很大的安慰。
referenceEn: Her words gave me a lot of comfort.
Her words were a great comfort to me.
rubricZh: comfort 當名詞「安慰」，常用 give comfort、be a comfort to 等說法
說的是過去的事，可用過去式（例如 gave、were）
「很大的」可寫 a lot of、great 等

referenceEn: This book is full of humor.
This book is really full of humor.
rubricZh: 用 humor 表示「幽默」（例如 is full of humor）
